name: What should be included in a luxury installation quote?

mainEntity.name: What line items should a homeowner expect in a detailed quote for high-end fixture and material installation?
mainEntity.text: What line items should a homeowner expect in a detailed quote for high-end fixture and material installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury installation quotes should be detailed enough to prevent confusion later. At a minimum, the proposal should identify material supply, fabrication, delivery, installation labor, demolition, surface protection, sealing, finish cleanup, and any plumbing or electrical tie-ins. It should also clarify allowances, lead times, and what happens if hidden conditions are found after work begins. Homeowners should check whether the bid includes template visits, special handling for heavy slabs, disposal fees, and post-install punch-list corrections. A vague quote may look cheaper at first but often leads to disputes once the project is underway. The best quotes define what is included, what is excluded, and how changes are approved so the homeowner can compare contractors on equal terms.
acceptedAnswer.description: A strong luxury installation quote should separate materials, fabrication, labor, demo, delivery, protection, sealing, plumbing or electrical tie-ins, and cleanup. It should also state what is excluded, who handles warranty issues, and whether change orders are billed separately.
